collection.description: An eccentric elder warns that an old footpath will soon become difficult to cross, though the sky is clear.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (elder), an eccentric elder, warns that an old footpath will soon become difficult to cross, though the sky is clear.

choices.label: Ask What Signs the Elder Saw
Choose an Alternate Route for Now
Thank the Elder Without Promising Belief

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The group discovers erosion (elder) had noticed earlier.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The route appears sound, and no one treats uncertainty as proof of foolishness.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (elder) describes subtle changes in the soil.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (elder) admits the warning came from a vivid dream rather than observation.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The detour is pleasant and uneventful.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The detour is exhausting, and the group discusses how to weigh uncertain warnings.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (elder) appreciates being heard even without agreement.

d2__fx.name: Outcome D2
d2__fx.text: (elder) laughs and says their predictions are wrong as often as anyone's.
